title: Recognizing that the United States has a moral and legal obligation to provide reparations for the crime of enslavement of Africans and its lasting harm on the lives of millions of Black people in the United States.
latestAction: Referred to the House Committee on the Judiciary.
policyArea: Civil Rights and Liberties, Minority Issues
summary: This resolution recognizes the responsibility of the federal government to provide reparations and encourages the passage and implementation of the Commission to Study and Develop Reparation Proposals for African Americans Act.

actions.text: Referred to the House Committee on the Judiciary.
